prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: updated standalone bomber aircraft master for the FOUR-machine Social Brave King combination. Image 1 is the aircraft edit target. Images 2-4 are the approved combined front and selected rear/side, solely for component identity and colors. Render ONE complete aircraft in the same front three-quarter aircraft view as image 1, landscape canvas, ivory studio background, fully visible wing tips. Clean KINETIC_CEL hard-edged inked mecha illustration, confident black contour, large restrained cel-shaded surfaces, orange/ivory/graphite armor, blue-black glass. No text, no robot body, no hands or legs.

Keep this a broad, low, powerful futuristic bomber with TWO wide swept triangular main wings, TWO cylindrical engines slung under the wings, and ONE central fuselage/cockpit. Match the aircraft components visible on image 2, rather than redesigning the combined robot. Revise the old needle-shaped nose into the compact blunt faceted orange cockpit/nose from image 2: squared rounded wedge tip, saturated orange nose armor, dark blue panoramic canopy and ivory cheek frames. Shorten only the pointed beak; keep enough central fuselage length for a credible aircraft. Main wings are graphite panels with ivory leading edges and narrow orange stripes, exactly recognizable as the combined shoulder wings. Each engine has a forward-facing metallic intake fan and a cylindrical graphite/orange nacelle aligned front-to-back.

Add the TWO narrow orange-edged graphite vertical tail fins corresponding to the combined backpack fins: mounted aft on the two sides of the central fuselage, inboard of the main wings. Do not put fins on wing tips. Between them the rear central body has a recognizable orange-framed machinery pack with two rectangular dark vent grilles; this component becomes the robot backpack when fitted. Distinguish this vent module from the two outboard engine exhausts. Add clean mechanical separation seams and a visible circular wing-root pivot between central body and each wing/engine carrier, so the carriers can move without trapping the robot's shoulder joints. This is a simple credible modular toy/mecha assembly, not detailed mechanical simulation. Preserve the image 1 overall aircraft silhouette, view and rendering precision, but match the current approved orange/ivory/graphite distribution and the revised blunt nose/twin fins. Avoid giant all-white wings, long pointed nose, extra engines, extra fins, rails, lettering, logos or a new mecha face.
